name: Warrior
flavorText: You're a fighter, first and foremost, and know how to apply your skills on and off the battlefield.

name: Captain
flavorText: You have practice ordering people around.

name: Diplomat
flavorText: You know how to talk your way through almost anything.

name: Scholar
flavorText: You are well read and contain a wealth of knowledge.

name: Healer
flavorText: You are trained to tend to the sick and injured.

name: Scoundrel
flavorText: You're a master of stealth and intrigue.

name: Peasant
flavorText: You were born to a lower class—the farmers, the laborers, the craftsmen, the poor. It has left you with certain knowledge of the world.

name: Merchant
flavorText: You may be low born, but are well off and educated, and have social privileges the peasants do not.

name: High Born
prerequisiteText: Requires the Petty Nobility, Landed Nobility, or Royalty social class
flavorText: You are an important person, and everyone knows it. Your opinions are destined to shape the land, so others treat you differently.

name: Carouser
flavorText: If partying is an art, then you're a maestro, an expert in having a good time and using its opportunities to your advantage.

name: Jester
flavorText: You are a professional goofball, skilled at using your hijinks and ability to entertain to get what you want.

name: Knight
flavorText: Honorbound and oathsworn, you are tasked with defending the weak and upholding justice.

name: Magnate
flavorText: You come from wealth, either inherited or by your own shrewd investment.

name: Priest
flavorText: You are a religious figure, respected even by many not of your own faith.

name: Rake
flavorText: The allure of your charm draws folk of all kinds to you, and you know just how to take advantage of it.

name: Retainer
flavorText: An artist, a servant, a philosopher. Whatever you are, you have made a life working in the service of others.

name: Romantic
flavorText: Though the world can often be complicated and grim, it has never been able to stomp out your idealistic, dreamer's heart.

name: Vizier
flavorText: You are the whisper in the king's ear, the right hand of the crown, and the true power behind the throne.

name: Magician
flavorText: As a Magician, you can use Arcane Magick in your everyday life.

name: Theurgist
flavorText: With enough faith and blessings from above, you channel Light Magick in all things.

name: Witch
flavorText: You practice a Dark Magick, one that scrapes against the edges of the world, testing its limits...

name: Sword Adept
flavorText: You are especially trained with the sword, and can use the weapon to its fullest potential.

name: Axe Adept
flavorText: You are especially trained with the axe, and can use the weapon to its fullest potential.

name: Spear Adept
flavorText: You are especially trained with the spear, and can use the weapon to its fullest potential.

name: Bow Adept
flavorText: You are especially trained with the bow, and can use the weapon to its fullest potential.

name: Gauntlet Adept
flavorText: For you, every battle is a fistfight.

name: Cavalry Adept
flavorText: You are trained in cavalry combat, and are especially effective on the battlefield while mounted.

name: Rapier Adept
flavorText: You know how to bring a rapier to the battlefield.

name: Thrown Weapons Adept
flavorText: You are uniquely trained in using thrown weapons.

name: Antagonist
flavorText: Your presence on the battlefield strikes terror in the hearts of your enemies.

name: Bannerlord
flavorText: Your presence on the battlefield inspires courage in your allies.

name: Berserker
flavorText: Every time you enter battle, a red haze falls over your eyes. It dulls the senses and quiets the mind, and when it passes, you often find yourself victorious, with a trail of blood and destruction left in your wake.

name: Buckler Master
flavorText: You know how to use a small but simple shield to its full effect.

name: Combat Medic
flavorText: Where others throw themselves into battle to hurt people, you do it to help them.

name: Commander
flavorText: You are skilled in the art of command.

name: Close Protection
flavorText: When you keep your allies close, you keep them safe.

name: Defensive Stance
flavorText: Sometimes the best offense is a good defense.

name: Defensive Wall
flavorText: You are the wall standing between death and your allies.

name: Demoralizing Attacker
flavorText: In the thick of battle, your words have an edge as sharp as your blade.

name: Dirty Fighter
flavorText: The rules of honorable combat are for cowards. You know better.

name: Dual Wielding
flavorText: You have trained to wield two weapons at once.

name: Duelist
flavorText: You do best in single combat.

name: Feint
flavorText: You deceive your opponents to create an opening.

name: Fortified Mind
flavorText: It takes more than a little shouting to shake your resolve.

name: Heavy Lifting
flavorText: The power behind your blows is enough to crush anyone and everyone that crosses your path.

name: Helping Hand
flavorText: Your best asset is to be an asset.

name: Hunter Seeker
flavorText: No one stays hidden from you for long...

name: Icon
flavorText: Your inspiring presence keeps your allies in the fight.

name: Impenetrable
flavorText: When in battle, no one gets past you without your permission.

name: Insurmountable
flavorText: You are an immovable object.

name: Juggernaut
flavorText: You are an unstoppable force.

name: Mage's Bane
flavorText: Magic is the coward's weapon, and you hate cowards.

name: Opportunist
flavorText: You know how to spot an opening.

name: Overwhelming
flavorText: You demoralize your enemies with even greater efficiency.

name: Poisoner
flavorText: You are adept at using poisons to augment your weapon attacks.

name: Provocateur
flavorText: You are especially infuriating to your enemies.

name: Rally
flavorText: You inspire and coordinate your allies.

name: Rapport
flavorText: Your bond is your strength.

name: Resilient
flavorText: It's going to take more than just a couple hits to knock you down.

name: Shield Master
flavorText: You've trained with shields before, and know how to use them to their fullest potential.

name: Skirmisher
flavorText: You are quick into battle and quick to get out of it.

name: Sleepytime
flavorText: You are especially practiced at the careful art of laying your enemies flat on their backs.

name: Stealthy Fighter
flavorText: You are especially adept at using stealth to take advantage of the battlefield chaos.

name: Swift Steps
flavorText: You move through the battlefield, quick and light as a feather.

name: Tactician
flavorText: You have studied the art of command.

name: Trapper
flavorText: Your enemy better watch their step...

name: Unarmored Master
flavorText: You work best unencumbered.

name: Vengeful
flavorText: Your preferred method of fighting is waiting for your enemy to show their hand before retaliating.

name: War Healer
flavorText: Wielding a weapon doesn't mean you can't also heal.

name: Willing Shield
flavorText: You know that death comes for everyone on the battlefield, but not them. You won't let it. If the target of your Willing Shield dies, any and all of your Willing Shield talents are replaced with their Disgraced Shield counterparts. (You may also choose to start with Disgraced Shield talents as part of your character's backstory)

name: Wrestler
flavorText: You're not afraid to get hands-on with your opponents.

name: Arcane Magick
flavorText: You have unlocked the secrets of Arcane Magick - a domain of magick that seeks to reveal the mysteries of the world through reliable models and experimentation.

name: Cryomancer
flavorText: Cold is one of the fundamental energies, opposed by flame. As a Cryomancer you have an expertise in wielding bitter cold against your enemies.

name: Fulgermancer
flavorText: Lightning is one of the fundamental energies, once thought to be exclusive to the skies, now conjurable with arcane understanding. As a fulgermancer you have an expertise in wielding the awesome power of thunder and lightning.

name: Pyromancer
flavorText: Fire is said to be the first fundamental energy tamed by the ancient wizards. It is a more primal magick, spreading and growing with a life of its own. As a pyromancer, you have a knack for controlling the most fearsome flames.

name: Dark Magick
flavorText: You have gained the blasphemous power of Dark Magick - a domain of magick that deals with shadows, death, and blood. The Dark Arts are reviled by most, but a study in them reveals potential to change the world in ways thought impossible.

name: Hemocraft
flavorText: Blood is the medium of life in living things, and you know its secrets. A blasphemous domain of research, you may use your mastery of blood to spread disease and cure disease alike.

name: Noctocraft
flavorText: The night is the absence of the life-giving light of the sun, and this is where you best dwell. Shadow-magick is the energy of death, and is mightiest when its user allows themself to be close to that threshold.

name: Thymocraft
flavorText: One of the most reviled acts of dark magick is to twist and drain energy from someone's immortal soul. As a practitioner of thymocraft your magick reaches directly past the body to harm their very essence, fueling your own.

name: Light Magick
flavorText: You are blessed with the miraculous power of Light Magick - a domain of magick said to come from the divine forces that breathe life into every being. You are a conduit, a vessel for the will of something greater than any single being.

name: Auraturge
flavorText: Auras are a magickal manifestation most associated with the saints of old, who had a presence of grace that emboldened the faithful.

name: Luminurge
flavorText: The Light that a blessed priest can conjure is unlike any other magickal light - the same life giving energy that Sun shines upon the land. As a luminurge, you are blessed to wield this awesome raw power as a sword and shield against your foes.

name: Vitalurge
flavorText: The power to lay on hands and mend wounds is the most well-known manifestation of divine grace. As a vitalurge, you have a great power to stop your allies from falling from their wounds.

name: Augmentier
flavorText: Wands, orbs, divine symbols, cursed catalysts. Whatever your spellcraft or prayers may be, you have an expertise at wielding such objects of power to enhance your magick.

name: Counterspell
flavorText: On the battlefield, your magick is your shield against blade and spell alike.

name: Gremorie
flavorText: There is power in the written word, and you know it better than anyone. Whether it be by carrying arcane tomes filled with formulae and geometry, hallowed texts of psalms and saintly philosophy, or profane curses and sigils, you can use these magick writings to their fullest potential.

name: Shadow Cloak
flavorText: Using magick to make yourself invisible is a nasty, dishonorable trick - the magick of thieves and rogues. You are a master of this art.

name: Spellblade
flavorText: You have learned to channel your Magick through a weapon, to devastating effect.

name: Spellshot
flavorText: You have learned to channel your Magick through a ranged weapon.

name: Warp
flavorText: Teleportation is the trickiest, most disorientating magick for a mage to learn. To you, it's easier than riding a horse.
